title: Joseph McMoneagle awarded the Legion of Merit for remote viewing

tellings.quote: you have guys like Joseph mcmonagle who have won the Legion of Merit for over 200 instances

plain: Joseph McMoneagle, a man who worked as a "remote viewer" for the US government (someone said to describe faraway places and things using only the mind), is said to have won the Legion of Merit, a high US military award, for over 200 instances of this work. Michels says this himself, without naming a source, as evidence that the government took such abilities seriously.
